设计意图： Asymmetric volatility ratio between upward and downward moves using a longer 60-day window to capture more stable downside fragility. The parent used a 30-day window with additional 10-day smoothing; this mutation extends the base window to 60 days and removes the smoothing layer to reduce complexity and noise while preserving the core economic mechanism. 🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 pos_ret：returns.where(returns > 0, 0.0)
  2. 计算 neg_ret：returns.where(returns < 0, 0.0)
  3. 计算 window：60
  4. 计算 vol_up：pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=30).std(ddof=1)
  5. 计算 vol_down：neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=30).std(ddof=1)
  6. 计算 ratio：vol_down / vol_up
  7. 计算 ratio：ratio

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_upside_vol_ratio_60(df): df_copy = df.copy() returns = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() pos_ret = returns.where(returns > 0, 0.0) neg_ret = returns.where(returns < 0, 0.0) window = 60 vol_up = pos_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=30).std(ddof=1) vol_down = neg_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=30).std(ddof=1) ratio = vol_down / vol_up.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_downside_upside_vol_ratio_60'] = ratio "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_downside_upside_vol_ratio_60']
